seen.title: JDE Orchestrator: overriding the AIS job queue per call (fire-and-forget)
seen.notes: Bun/TS demo calling the same orchestration sync (200 + output after ~4s) and fire-and-forget via jde__jobQueue=JDE__ASYNCH (202 in ms), with side-by-side timings, a mock AIS server honoring the override, a mock Orchestrator Monitor status check, and an optional PowerShell client.
